How listing works

01

Create the listing

Add photos, the floor plan, the price and the smart tier. It takes about fifteen minutes.

02

We review it

Our team checks the title, your identity and the property. Most listings are live within one working day.

03

Enquiries arrive

Buyers and tenants chat through the app or request a viewing. Everything lands in your lead inbox.

04

You pay monthly

Secure card or M-Pesa payment, invoiced monthly. Cancel any time and the listing comes down the same day.

Start a listing

Send us the basics and we will set the listing up with you, or create the account first and do it yourself in the dashboard.

Listing rules

What we reject, and why

We moderate every listing before it goes live, and we suspend accounts that repeatedly breach the rules. This is what keeps buyers trusting the verified badge.

  • ×Listings where the person posting cannot show a title, lease or written authority
  • ×The same property posted more than once to game search results
  • ×Prices that differ from the price quoted to enquirers
  • ×Photographs that are not of the property being listed
  • ×Properties that are not actually available
  • ×Listings that misrepresent the smart tier or the amenities fitted
